title: India's SBI Card posts higher quarterly profit on asset quality boost
description: SBI Cards announced an impressive profit surge attributed to lower provisions for bad loans. A remarkable rise in card spending highlighted robust consumer and corporate appetite, alongside a boost in total revenue propelled by increased transaction volumes across their card offerings. Furthermore, the company's asset quality has notably improved with a decline in gross non-performing assets and a significant yearly drop in loan loss provisions and credit costs.

title: Yen heads for biggest weekly drop since May despite Tokyo's support pledges
description: The Japanese yen is experiencing a dramatic drop, marking its most significant weekly decline since May. The currency has hit 40-year lows against the US dollar, compounded by Japan's ineffective measures to bolster its value. Additionally, surging oil prices have reignited inflation worries, further enhancing the dollar's strength, while the euro and sterling have seen slight increases against it.

title: Sebi bars former Axis MF dealer Viresh Joshi from securities markets for 7 years front-running case
description: Sebi has banned Viresh Joshi and Prijesh Kurani from the securities market for seven years.  This action stems from a front-running case involving Axis Mutual Fund trades.  The regulator also ordered Rs 30.56 crore in impounded funds to be treated as disgorgement.  Joshi allegedly shared non-public fund information with Kurani for illicit trading.  The scheme involved multiple individuals and entities facilitating these wrongful gains.

title: Quote of the day by John Rogers: "All of us, all of the time, have to be on guard against groupthink"
description: Veteran investor John Rogers emphasizes the constant need to guard against groupthink.  This phenomenon occurs when individuals conform to group views instead of independent evaluation.   Encouraging diverse perspectives and challenging assumptions improves decision-making in various settings.
